description: The scenes of WORK_SCENES (src/test-utils.ts) that have no test yet, each with the work that adds it. The work that adds the test of a scene removes its row; a row whose scene has a test fails scripts/gates/work-scenes.mjs, so the list only gets shorter.

scenes.selectAll: the work that keeps the selected ids in a set read without an array, and selects every feature of a layer or of a box
scenes.releasePart: the work that shows a drag without writing the document and writes it in parts when the pointer is released
scenes.writeBack: the work that writes the values kept from before a change back into the document
scenes.interleavedLayers: the work that draws the features of a layer from their rows, in the order of the layer, with points, lines and polygons interleaved
